text.p: Here are the highlights of stories in the Danish press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

--- Telecom group Tele Danmark is blocking 130,000 telephone subscribers from accepting cheaper offers from competitors by refusing to modernise its network to make connection for cheaper calls technically possible.
--- Danish companies give high priority to a listing on the Copenhagen stock exchange and a record of 35 companies are now preparing to enter the stock market in 1997.

--- Copenhagen is one of Europe's leading scientific research centres, but Danish companies have not been able to turn this knowledge into new production and jobs, a new Copenhagen University survey says, blaming lack of cooperation between the university and business.

--- Following the breakdown of budget talks with the Social Democrat-led government over its plans to raise taxes the Conservatives plan to draft tax reform plans of their own ahead of the 1998 general election.
